title: Equipment supply and installation dispute · Four parties · Four time points (illustrative data)

sources.name: Equipment supply contract
sources.quote: The equipment shall be delivered to site and installed and commissioned by 30 June 2024.

sources.name: Supervisor's inspection record
sources.quote: Unpacking inspection found the nameplate parameters inconsistent with the contract annex; this was recorded on the spot and the supplier was notified.

sources.name: Acceptance minutes
sources.quote: Because the parameters did not match, acceptance failed and the supplier was required to replace the equipment within fifteen days.

events.label: Buyer and supplier sign the equipment supply contract
events.detail: The contract price for the equipment was CNY 4.2 million (including transport, installation and commissioning), and the supplier was to deliver to site and complete commissioning by 30 June.

events.label: Supplier delivers the equipment to site
events.detail: The supplier delivered all the equipment to site and completed handover, ten days earlier than the agreed date.

events.label: Supervisor inspects the unpacked equipment
events.detail: On unpacking inspection the supervisor found that the nameplate parameters of two units were inconsistent with the contract annex, recorded this on the spot and notified the supplier.

events.label: Installer completes installation and commissioning
events.detail: The installer completed the mechanical installation and pipework connections; because of the parameter issue, no energised trial run was carried out.

events.label: Joint acceptance by all four parties fails
events.detail: The buyer, supervisor, supplier and installer carried out acceptance jointly; it failed because the parameters did not match, and the supplier was required to replace the equipment within fifteen days.
